findings.label: No-publish render harness can post to X
findings.detail: src/mastra/demo/rasRenderTest.ts (exposed as `npm run ras:render:test` in package.json) calls runHandoff with dryRun:false and approved:true and replaces only the Instagram `publish` dep with a fake that returns { published: true }. It does not inject safe X dependencies, so defaultHandoffDeps.xPublish (the real publishToX wrapper) runs with args.dryRun === false once the fake Instagram publisher reports success. With a logged-in browser session, this render-only harness can create a real X post while Instagram stays faked, breaking the command's no-publish contract and its printed promise that no real post was created. Fix: inject a safe X dependency into this harness (e.g. xReady: async () => ({ ok: false, reason: 'render test' }) or a dry-run/fake xPublish), state in the output that neither channel published, and add a regression asserting X is not called.

findings.label: Demo dump shows "(0/280)" for an empty caption
findings.detail: src/mastra/demo/autoNewsDryRun.ts formats xCaption as `${xCaption} (${length}/280)` without the empty-caption guard the approval preview received, so an empty deterministic caption prints "(0/280)" in the offline debug dump. Debug output only, not user-facing. Mirror the preview's "(no X caption — X post will be skipped)" string if consistency is wanted.
